data.name: Altered Defense
data.description: You learned early on to modify the patterns around you to grant yourself protection as a swift action. You choose from the options below and may only have one such effect active at any given time. You can use this ability for %1 rounds per day. You can maintain this ability as long as you want as long as you have rounds available, or dismiss it at any time as a free action.  Absorb: You gain DR %3/-.  Deflect: You gain a +%2 dodge bonus to AC.  Retaliate: You gain a +%2 bonus on your attack rolls against any opponent that successfully hit you since your last turn.|AlteredDefenseRounds|AlteredDefenseBonus|AlteredDefenseDR
